#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s RELEASE_DIRECTORY\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

release=$1
case $release in
    /*) candidate=$release ;;
    *)  candidate=$base/$release ;;
esac

if [ ! -d "$candidate" ]; then
    printf 'publish: release directory does not exist: %s\n' "$release" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "$candidate/MANIFEST" ]; then
    printf 'publish: release is missing MANIFEST: %s\n' "$release" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Build the replacement beside current, then atomically rename it into place.
# Readers therefore resolve either the old complete release or the new one;
# current is never deliberately unlinked.
tmp=$base/.current.$$
cleanup() {
    rm -f -- "$tmp"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
ln -s -- "$release" "$tmp"
mv -Tf -- "$tmp" "$base/current"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM

(

        if [ ! -L "$base/current" ] || [ ! -f "$base/current/MANIFEST" ] || [ ! -f "$base/current/index.txt" ]; then
            failures=$((failures + 1))
            continue

        manifest=
        index=
        IFS= read -r manifest < "$base/current/MANIFEST" || failures=$((failures + 1))
        IFS= read -r index < "$base/current/index.txt" || failures=$((failures + 1))

        checks=$((checks + 1))

    printf 'reader_checks=%s reader_failures=%s\n' "$checks" "$failures" > "$result"
) &

iterations=600
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt "$iterations" ]; do
    "$base/bin/publish" releases/two

done
